summary: Tested Boat Inventory, suggested cupboards from the admin, the zone map, area tags/filter and the watermark on backend and frontend. Backend: new tests/test_inventory.py passes 16/16. It covers /inventory/shared (401 when signed out, shape), zone-map GET (401 when signed out, 404 when there is none), admin POST/DELETE (403 for pro/free, 400 for text or files over 3MB, a PNG round trip the free user can read, remove makes zone_map_v null and the GET 404), area-defaults (403 for non-admin, 400 for an empty or blank list, case-insensitive dedupe and trim, persisted), PUT /me/boat keeping areas when omitted and saving when sent, and email-log with ['boatInventory'] storing 'Area: Item xN' lines with the on-board state, plus the PDF. Regression: test_multi_boats + test_crew_photos 48/48. Frontend: Admin passes every inventory flow (add cupboard incl. empty/duplicate errors, expand, add item with empty/qty/duplicate errors, tick on board and the x/y count, edit dialog incl. duplicate error, delete item, rename incl. duplicate error, delete cupboard via the confirm dialog, persistence after reload), the clone/rename warning toasts, zone map open/replace (resized to 1600px)/remove/upload, and publish ('4 cupboard names published'). Pro: sees the zone map and can open it full size, with no upload/remove/publish buttons; the suggestions dialog (none-selected error, Select All, added names are no longer suggested); the area picker shows only once cupboards exist; tag -> chip; the filter (All / used area / No area) filters correctly; area-filter-empty appears; flag/move tools are hidden on My To Do while filtering; untag works; tags survive a reload. A second boat gets the same cupboard names with empty contents; Reset All with Select All leaves the inventory unchanged; deleting a cupboard removes the chip and the filter. Free: inventory-locked and the upgrade button opens the plan dialog; no area picker; no filter. Crew (beta on the admin boat): inventory is read-only (no add/rename/delete/suggest/zone tools, toggles disabled). Watermark: shown on the admin main boat (opacity 0.08, full viewport) and hidden on a boat without a photo (admin's 2nd boat, pro and free). At 390px there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390); the add-item name input is 200px wide. I found and FIXED 2 frontend bugs (see updated_files).

minor.issue: Only $unset path / overwrite. The old object stays in storage, so orphans build up (the same pattern as boat photos).
areas is merged as a single section (last sec_ts wins) and has no per-item ts. Inventory edits made on two phones offline lose one side completely, unlike the per-item merge for checklists.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: an on-board item showed an empty white tick box with an invisible white check, because the row lacked the 'is-checked' class the .tick-box CSS relies on. I added is-checked to the li.

FIXED: the native min=1/max=9999 validation on type=number blocked form submit, so the custom 'Quantity must be a whole number...' error never appeared (a stale earlier error stayed visible). I added noValidate to both forms. Verified the qty error now shows.

issues: Cupboard names wrap onto 3-6 lines because the count and 2 icon buttons sit on the same row. Consider moving the 'x/y on board' count under the name.
The reason line says 'Boat inventory is a Pro feature', but the Pro feature bullet list doesn't include Boat inventory or area tags.

action_items: Optional: add 'Boat inventory and area tags' to the Pro features list in the plan dialog.
Optional: at 390px put the inventory-area-count under the cupboard name to reduce wrapping.
Optional: give inventory items a ts and merge areas per cupboard/item like checklists, so 2 devices don't overwrite each other.
Optional: delete old zone-map objects from storage on replace/remove.
critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.saveEdit rebuilds the item as {id, checked, flagged, label, area?}, dropping any other fields (e.g. ts). Spread ...i first and then delete area when editArea is empty.
Deleting a cupboard leaves orphan item.area ids in checklist data. The display handles it (areaName null), but the ids linger. You could strip them in the delete handler.
useInventoryShared caches mbp_inventory_shared in localStorage for every account on the device. This is harmless (zone map GET needs auth), but it isn't per user.
SuggestAreasDialog keys rows by name. That's fine because the server dedupes (case-insensitively).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% after 2 small fixes (before the fixes: the tick visual and the qty error were broken)

seed_data_creation: As E1 asked, everything was cleaned at the end: DELETE /api/boats/main/photo (admin), DELETE zone map, db.app_settings area_defaults deleted, areas [] on admin/pro/free/beta boats, extra boats (pro TEST_Second, pytest TEST_inv1, admin TEST_NoPhoto) deleted, admin boat vessel/skipper/callsign cleared, beta removed from admin crew, pro TEST_todo items and area tags removed, last_boat unset. Note: the admin's first cupboard did NOT contain 'Spare impeller x2' when testing started (items were empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_inventory.py (it snapshots and restores the app_settings zone_map/area_defaults). The pro user's registry lacks leavingDock (old test data); use 'head' (item id 123) for tagging. To test crew, add test-user-beta to the admin main boat's crew in Mongo and set localStorage mbp_boats_active='c_test-admin-1_main'. The sync debounce is 700ms, so wait 2-3s after edits before closing the page or checking the DB.
